cases.title: After an Edit Pipe cascade from P3, U and REDO, the Pit Schedule rows of P3 and P2 carry the new levels, and after two more U every schedule row reads exactly as before the edit
cases.plan_item: Edit Pipe cascade with U and REDO, the stored-level half (gap plan section 3 item 7; card C40; R11 covers the IL texts)
cases.expected: Before the edit the P3 row reads FROM P4, 450, 17.30, 450, 17.25, cover 18.88. Edit Pipe on 10A98D with 17.60 / 17.50, Recalculate Yes and Apply say 'Updated 4 pipes and 3 pits from P3 (IL 17.50)'; one U echoes CDEDIT; after 12 s REDO says 'Everything has been redone'; the Pit Schedule then shows the P3 row with inlet 17.50 and outlet 17.45 and the P2 row with inlet 17.33 and outlet 17.28; two U (PITSCHEDULE, then CDEDIT) and the schedule rows read exactly as before the edit.
cases.why_not_unit: The real Edit Pipe window, the downstream recalculation, CE's stored records, the schedule and AutoCAD's undo stack all take part; only a live drawing shows that U and REDO carry the stored levels too.
not_automated: The Recalculate box body and the STUB to X1 warning are not proved (as R11).
Pipe-by-pipe stored grades are not read (the schedule shows pit levels, not grades).
